tree: Built on what your business actually did.
Projections start from your own last months of sales, product costs, staff shifts and opening hours, so a change is tested against how your customers really behave.

tree.style: margin: 26px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 12px; font-size: 14.5px; color: #40514a;

tree: Every result is a likely range, not a promise.
Confidence drops when there’s little history to learn from.
Nothing changes in your business until you apply it yourself.

tree.style: display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: 48px; align-items: start;

background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 20px;

tree: What can I change in a scenario?
Prices, discounts and promotions, staff hours and shifts, opening days and hours, and product costs.

tree.style: background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 20px;

tree: Where do the projections come from?
From your own recent sales, costs and staffing in Noxtill, including how sales moved after past changes.

tree.style: background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 20px;

tree: Every result is shown as a likely range with a confidence level. Short histories and unusual weeks lower the confidence.

tree.style: background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 20px;

tree: Does running a scenario change anything?
No. Scenarios are sandboxed. You apply a change yourself in the module it belongs to when you are ready.

tree.style: background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(16,32,26,.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 20px;

tree: Can I share a scenario with my manager?
Yes. Saved scenarios can be opened by anyone on your team with access to Business Intelligence.

tree: Decide with the numbers in front of you.
